reveal: The correct answer is the RLS Legacy! [excited] RLS for Robert Louis Stevenson. The Hispaniola was the ship in his original novel.

clue: Bernard and Bianca are agents of this mouse organization that meets in the basement of the United Nations building.
reveal: The correct answer is the Rescue Aid Society! [chuckles] The world's most adorable international spy agency.

clue: Chicken Little's widowed dad, a former baseball star, has this name.
reveal: The correct answer is Buck Cluck! [laughs] Garry Marshall voiced him. Turkey Lurkey is the mayor.

clue: In the Enchanted Forest, Elsa befriends the fire spirit, a little salamander with this name.
reveal: The correct answer is Bruni! [excited] Gale is the wind and the Nokk is the water horse. Snowflakes for Bruni!

clue: Andy's toys end up at this daycare, ruled by a strawberry-scented bear.
reveal: The correct answer is Sunnyside Daycare! [sarcastic] Sunny? Not with Lotso in charge. The Butterfly Room is just one room there.

clue: The Marine Life Institute in Finding Dory is in this real California coastal town.
reveal: The correct answer is Morro Bay! [whispers] Dory always remembered... the jewel of Morro Bay, California.

clue: Vanellope falls for this gritty online racing game, home of the street racer Shank.
reveal: The correct answer is Slaughter Race! [laughs] Sugar Rush was her home game. Gal Gadot voiced Shank.
